Paul Seixas Wins Giro di Lombardia Monument Race

French cyclist Paul Seixas won the Giro di Lombardia on Saturday, marking his first Monument victory. The 20-year-old finished ahead of Spain's Enric Mas and Italy's Giulio Ciccone, attacking 19 km from the finish in Como, Italy. Seixas is the fourth-youngest winner of a Monument race.
